title: What are you doing this weekend?
content_html:
In general: We've had like 70cm of snow since last night so I'm gonna go dig out my car.

In coding: I'm kind of stunned at how many improvement opportunities I keep finding by staring at the small toy version of the index I've ported to C++. I've already found postings list design changes that effectively eliminate pointer chasing. Postings decompression is twice as fast too (not from the port, but from some tweaks to the logic).

Now I found some disk locality issues with term positions that I've been working on fixing. Thing is, I haven't even gotten to implementing that bit in C++ yet. Got a prototype in prod for the Java version and it's dropped read amplification by like 80-90% for these tasks.

I've been meaning to write a blog post about what I've found so far but the moment I get half way through putting pen to paper I find something else.
